content.summary: Aerospace and defense company Howmet (NYSE:HWM) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 13.8% year on year to $2.09 billion. The company expects next quarter’s revenue to be around $2.1 billion, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.95 per share was 4.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
